name: Andaaz-e-Lahore
text: Andaaz-e-Lahore in Lahore, Punjab serves Punjabi and Mughlai food. Signature dish: Lahori Chargha. Price range Rs. 600-1200. A Gawalmandi institution known for chargha steamed overnight in spices then flash-fried to order. Open daily 1pm-1am. Good for family style, late night dining.

name: Kolachi
text: Kolachi in Karachi, Sindh serves Pakistani seafood BBQ. Signature dish: Kolachi Fish Tikka. Price range Rs. 1200+. Harbour-side grills at Do Darya with fresh pomfret and shrimp grilled over open coals, known for its waterfront view. Open daily 12pm-12am.

name: Namak Mandi Charsi Tikka
text: Namak Mandi Charsi Tikka in Peshawar, Khyber Pakhtunkhwa serves Pathan karahi. Signature dish: Charsi Tikka Karahi, mutton cooked in its own fat in a decades-old blackened pan. No menu, eaten by hand. Open daily 11am-11pm. Budget to mid-range.

name: Quetta Sajji House
text: Quetta Sajji House in Quetta, Balochistan serves traditional Balochi sajji: whole lamb or chicken salted and roasted upright over an open wood fire. Good for sharing among a group. Open daily 12pm-10pm. Price range Rs. 1200+.

name: Cafe Aylanto
text: Cafe Aylanto in Karachi, Sindh is a contemporary Pakistani-Italian fusion restaurant. Signature dish: Lahori Chicken Pasta. Good for date night, reservation recommended. Open daily 12pm-11pm. Price range Rs. 1200+.

name: Cheena Lahore
text: Cheena Lahore in Lahore, Punjab serves Desi Chinese food, heavy on garlic and chilli. Signature dish: Dragon Chicken. Open daily 5pm-2am, good for late night spicy wok food.

name: Student Biryani
text: Student Biryani in Karachi, Sindh, started in 1964, is a citywide budget chain famous for its chicken biryani with potato. Open daily 11am-1am. Price range Rs. 300-600. Quick and affordable.

name: Haveli Rooftop
signatureDish: Mutton Karahi with a Fort view
text: Haveli Rooftop on Food Street, Lahore, Punjab serves traditional Punjabi mutton karahi with a rooftop view of Badshahi Mosque and Lahore Fort. Reservation recommended for weekend window tables. Open daily 6pm-1am.
